_: What this version of Tessera is tested with. Software Update reads the version it's about to install, so an Arch update can be held back until Tessera supports it. Packages: tools/packages.sh.

hyprland.why: The Lua config and the glass plugin (hypr/plugin/tessera-glass) are built against Hyprland 0.56.

quickshell.why: min: the oldest system Quickshell Tessera runs on (the installer builds its own, tools/build-quickshell.sh, when yours is older or missing). bundled: the version of that build (~/.local/share/tessera/quickshell), so Arch's quickshell updates don't affect it.
